name: MentalDx-Bench
description: A benchmark for evaluating model performance on diagnosing or reasoning about mental health conditions from clinical/vignette-style inputs. Measures diagnostic accuracy and reasoning fidelity across a set of curated cases intended to probe psychiatric/psychological knowledge. Designed for text-only models and clinical NLP tasks.
reputation: Niche clinical benchmark with limited but growing use in research on mental-health NLP systems.
